notes.title: Update: Controller Angle Settings added for Oculus and Index
notes.content:
-This update is to address the weapon holding angles for Index and Oculus. 
-Through feedback it was found that the weapon hold angles for Index and Oculus were pitched a little too high.
-The default hold angles of the game are set for a Vive/Vive Pro controller. 
-Settings options have been added to the player entry area which allow for a new default to be Oculus or Index.
-Setting for Oculus or Index will cause weapon pickups to pitch 15 degrees down from the Vive default. 
-This Setting change will be apparent when a map is entered and a weapon is picked up.
-The Setting is saved and will persist between play sessions.

notes.title: New Steam Achievements and Steam Stats! Plus Controller Mappings Fix!
notes.content:
As of V1.04  (now 1.043 after a few little tweaks) We now have a new mess of Steam Achievements and Steam Stats for just about everything. 47 Stats to track every bullet fired, every Target Dummy destroyed, all the little bits and pieces. 25 New Achievements with another stat based set to come very soon.

The Default Controller Mappings for Oculus and Index have been re-mapped to make more sense. There are now visual instructions for the main 3 controller types in the player start area. Vive, Index, Oculus. 

There's also a fun new joke in the Lobby. The "Billing System"

Enjoy :) so much more to come

notes.title: Update V 1.04 Achievements and Stats!
notes.content:
-A batch of new Steam Achievements by popular demand. More to come!
-Some arcade map achievements are checked when high scores or best times are set. If you already have set times and scores for a map you cannot defeat, the score reset buttons are on the back of the signs of each map. 
-Steam Stats for just about everything. 
-A new Lobby Joke: Billing System for the facility based on steam stats system. Gives you an estimate of what this would cost if it were IRL.

Enjoy :) 

-Magus

notes.title: Update: V1.03 Controller Mapping Fix for Index and Oculus
notes.content:
-Remapped the default controller inputs for the Index and Oculus controllers to work as intended. 
-Added in game visual instructions for the 3 main controller sets in the starting area. Vive, Oculus, Index.

notes.title: Thank you! More to Come!
notes.content:
I would like to thank everyone who has thus far come on board to play A.A.B.S. Less than 1% of the games that get released these days... they say never see a player to enjoy it. I'm personally thankful to everyone who has and will play and I genuinely hope you enjoy it. My early feedback from people around me was... It's Really fun. And that is what I hope to put in the world. Straight Up Satisfying Fun!

That being said... I am preparing a content update around the end of the month with many more to come. The goal of that first update will be to integrate Steam Achievements and Stats. Along with a handful of new weapons and any fixes to any bugs that are found. 

If you would love input on what weapons players would like added in the next content update. Head over to the community hub and let me know on the discussions board. 

The future beyond that includes more weapons and maps for a few updates and than we shall see :). 

Again, Thank You All! Those here and those to come :) 

Enjoy!

-Magus
MagiSoftWorks
